malware_usage.name: Agent Tesla
malware_usage.description: [Agent Tesla](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0331) is a spyware Trojan written for the .NET framework that has been observed since at least 2014.(Citation: Fortinet Agent Tesla April 2018)(Citation: Bitdefender Agent Tesla April 2020)(Citation: Malwarebytes Agent Tesla April 2020)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used Agent Tesla.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: jRAT
malware_usage.description: [jRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0283) is a cross-platform, Java-based backdoor originally available for purchase in 2012. Variants of [jRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0283) have been distributed via a software-as-a-service platform, similar to an online subscription model.(Citation: Kaspersky Adwind Feb 2016) (Citation: jRAT Symantec Aug 2018)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used jRAT.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: NETWIRE
malware_usage.description: [NETWIRE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0198) is a publicly available, multiplatform remote administration tool (RAT) that has been used by criminal and APT groups since at least 2012.(Citation: FireEye APT33 Sept 2017)(Citation: McAfee Netwire Mar 2015)(Citation: FireEye APT33 Webinar Sept 2017)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used NETWIRE.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: njRAT
malware_usage.description: [njRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385) is a remote access tool (RAT) that was first observed in 2012. It has been used by threat actors in the Middle East.(Citation: Fidelis njRAT June 2013)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used njRAT.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: Revenge RAT
malware_usage.description: [Revenge RAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0379) is a freely available remote access tool written in .NET (C#).(Citation: Cylance Shaheen Nov 2018)(Citation: Cofense RevengeRAT Feb 2019)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used Revenge RAT.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: Snip3
malware_usage.description: [Snip3](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1086) is a sophisticated crypter-as-a-service that has been used since at least 2021 to obfuscate and load numerous strains of malware including [AsyncRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1087), [Revenge RAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0379), [Agent Tesla](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0331), and [NETWIRE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0198).(Citation: Morphisec Snip3 May 2021)(Citation: Telefonica Snip3 December 2021)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used Snip3.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

tool_usage.name: Imminent Monitor
tool_usage.description: [Imminent Monitor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0434) was a commodity remote access tool (RAT) offered for sale from 2012 until 2019, when an operation was conducted to take down the Imminent Monitor infrastructure. Various cracked versions and variations of this RAT are still in circulation.(Citation: Imminent Unit42 Dec2019)

claim_assessments.statement: TA2541 uses or has used Imminent Monitor.
